name: Peptamen Semi-Elemental Peptide Formula (Nestle)
whyItWorks: Enzymatically hydrolyzed 100% whey peptide formulation with 70% of fat as rapid-absorbing Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCT). Formulated specifically for patients with impaired GI function, short bowel syndrome, or extensive mucosal damage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Consume chilled. Sip slowly over 30 minutes.
